'''Haisha Su Bnist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] who made a living as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and petty thief during the reign of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when she was eighteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, Bnist [[Death/Legends|killed]] an Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] while resisting arrest. A "dead or alive" [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was subsequently placed on Bnist by the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]], and she fled off-world, to seek the aid of her underworld contacts and go into hiding. The IOCI suspected that Bnist sought to acquire [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants in order to enhance her reflexes and the Imperials advised that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] considering taking on the contract commence their search for Bnist by making inquiries to [[Black market/Legends|black market]] cybernetics [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]].
